domains.description: Finite rectangular domains, each compiled from the world's deterministic solid field.

items.description: One finite navigation grid compiled from the world's collision and optional medium truth.

name.description: The stable domain name referenced by navigated producer targets.

kind.description: Whether cells follow ground, free 3D space, or a live medium.

origin.description: The world-space center of cell (0,0,0); for a surface domain, Y is the ground-probe baseline.

cellSize.description: The square cell width in world units.

width.description: The number of cells along world X.

depth.description: The number of cells along world Z.

agentRadius.description: The solid-clearance sphere radius. A medium domain also keeps this whole volume submerged.

arrivalDistance.description: How close a body must come before advancing to the next waypoint.

maxExpandedNodes.description: The hard A* expansion budget for one route search.

maxPathNodes.description: The hard stored-waypoint budget for one route.

layers.description: The number of cells along world Y; surface domains require one.

connectivity.description: The volume neighbour set; ignored by surface domains.

probeUp.description: For a surface domain, the ground-search distance above origin Y.

probeDown.description: For a surface domain, the ground-search distance below origin Y.

agentHeight.description: For a surface domain, the clearance capsule height.

maxStepHeight.description: For a surface domain, the greatest adjacent height delta.

maxSlopeDegrees.description: For a surface domain, the greatest adjacent slope.

medium.description: For a medium domain, the named lattice field that cells must remain inside.

shared.description: Optional shared reverse-search policy. Absent uses independent bounded A* searches. Shared searches are queued and advanced on subsequent simulation ticks, independently of any leader.

goalCapacity.description: Resident destination-cell trees. A full cache with pending work refuses another destination as capacity-limited; it never launches an unbudgeted independent search.

expandedNodesPerTick.description: Total reverse-Dijkstra expansions per simulation tick, shared fairly between pending resident goals. Each expansion inspects at most 26 edges. A tree can eventually settle every domain cell; the independent A* MaxExpandedNodes bound does not truncate a shared tree.
